question: By how much did the first charge capacity of the NMC622 recovered from cathode scraps fall short of the baseline's?
rendered:
According to page 6 of the document, the first charge capacities for the baseline and recovered NMC622 were 205.6 and 194.0 mAh/g, respectively.

To find the difference, subtract the recovered capacity from the baseline capacity: 
205.6 mAh/g - 194.0 mAh/g = 11.6 mAh/g

The recovered NMC622 fell short of the baseline by 11.6 mAh/g.
